errors.text: The proposed SPS condition is above 1000°C, whereas the target process uses 1000°C as the upper effective densification condition and treats higher temperatures as the grain-growth or decomposition boundary.
The hypothesis reintroduces post-hoc optimization by stating that milling duration must be adjusted or optimized, contrary to the requested thermodynamics-based commitment to approximately 6 hours.

The falsification logic is scientifically weak: indentation load dependence alone does not identify precipitation hardening and cannot isolate it from the indentation-size effect, surface condition, porosity, or microstructural heterogeneity.
The sole citation concerns a compositionally unrelated NbMoCrTiAl refractory alloy and cannot validate the claimed CoCrFeNiTi BCC-to-FCC transition or processing window.
